verdict.rationale: Square has a first-party developer docs page titled "Square Webhooks" at /docs/webhooks/overview, so it does ship a webhooks capability. The pack contains only that title, with no detail on how subscriptions work. missing for 10: documentation of registering webhook subscriptions, the catalog of subscribable event types, payload/signature verification details, retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
